## Summary

Fixes the guest-name signature overlapping the episode title on the EP05 carousel card, using the letter-spacing approach requested in #81 (an alternative to the backdrop fix in #78, intended for side-by-side preview comparison).

EP05's long title — "It's Our Mathematics: AI, Verification, and the Future of Math with Jeremy Avigad" — fills both clamped lines of `.card-title` (`-webkit-line-clamp: 2`), running under the absolutely-positioned `.episode-guest` signature. Tightening the title's letter-spacing pulls "Verification" up onto the first line so the title no longer fills the area beneath the signature.

## Changes

- **`quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx`** — added an optional per-episode `titleLetterSpacing` frontmatter field, applied as an inline `letter-spacing` style on the `.card-title` `<h4>` only when set. Mirrors the existing `guestOffset` knob, so cards without the field are unaffected.
- **`content/episodes/ep05.md`** — set `titleLetterSpacing: "-0.02em"` so the title tucks onto the first line and clears the guest signature.

## Verification

- Change is scoped to EP05 frontmatter plus the minimal opt-in component plumbing; ep02–ep04 cards render unchanged (no `titleLetterSpacing` set).
- `tsc` could not be run as a meaningful check here (`node_modules` is not installed in the CI sandbox); the edit is a small addition following the established `guestOffset` pattern.
- Please confirm on the surge.sh preview that the EP05 card title no longer overlaps the guest signature at desktop (300px) and mobile (260px/240px) widths, and tune the `-0.02em` value if needed.

Closes #81

in the ep title "It's Our Mathematics: AI, Verification, and the Future of Math with Jeremy Avigad" 

can you also remove "with Jeremy Avigad"

Done. I removed `with Jeremy Avigad` from the EP05 frontmatter title in [`content/episodes/ep05.md`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/agent/implement-issue-81/claude-27251430191/content/episodes/ep05.md), so it now reads:

> It's Our Mathematics: AI, Verification, and the Future of Math

The guest name still appears via the separate `.episode-guest` signature (rendered from `tags[0]`), so nothing is lost on the card.

One heads-up: since the title is now much shorter, the `titleLetterSpacing: "-0.02em"` tweak this PR added may no longer be needed to clear the overlap. I left it in place for now (it's the comparison approach from #81), but let me know if you'd like me to revert it back to normal spacing — worth checking the preview either way.

## Rubrics Update

No changes were committed to [`agent/rubrics`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/tree/agent/rubrics) from PR #82.

The `agent/rubrics` branch doesn't exist yet, and prior rubrics-update runs (#62, #66, #68) all resulted in no changes. I've reviewed the full PR #82 conversation.

**Decision: no rubric changes**

Reasoning:
- The only substantive human interaction was a single comment from `lolipopshock` asking to remove "with Jeremy Avigad" from the EP05 title (since the guest name already renders via the separate `.episode-guest` signature).
- This is a **one-off content edit** for one specific episode, not a repeated or explicitly-generalized preference. Generalizing it into a durable "never put guest names in episode titles" convention from a single data point would be speculative.
- `lolipopshock` is the de-facto primary operator (merges/reviews agent PRs per memory), but their `author_association` here is `CONTRIBUTOR`, and they did not ask to add/update a rubric — they requested a code change. The run request was the generic "learn rubrics if warranted."
- The guardrails favor `no rubric changes` for one-off, ambiguous feedback.

No files were created or modified under `/rubrics/`. **no rubric changes**
